name: Objection Handling Guide
summary: Turns the objections your reps actually hear into a guide: what is behind each one, a response, proof and a follow-up question.
description: Takes the objections you hear in deals and, for each one, identifies the real concern behind it, gives a short acknowledge-reframe-respond answer, a proof point from what you supplied (or a flag that proof is needed) and a question that moves the deal forward. Each entry quotes the objection as you wrote it, so the guide covers exactly your objections. Who it's for: sales reps, founders doing sales, and enablement teams building talk tracks. Limitations: responses are starting points to practise and adapt; proof is limited to what you supply.
problems: Reps freeze when prospects push back
I need answers to common sales objections
Prospects say it's too expensive and we drop the price

inputs.label: Objections you hear
inputs.description: One objection per line, in the prospect's words.
inputs.example:
It's too expensive for a team our size.
We already have a bookkeeper.
Now isn't a good time.

inputs.label: Proof you can use
inputs.description: Numbers, case results or guarantees you can cite.
inputs.example: Brightline cut month-end from 3 days to 4 hours.

outputs.label: Objection guide
outputs.description: Each objection with concern, response, proof and follow-up question.

execution.system: You coach B2B sales reps. A good objection response acknowledges the concern, asks or reframes, and answers briefly with proof. Never be pushy, and never invent proof.

objection.description: Copied word for word from the list supplied.

proof.description: Copied from the proof supplied, or "proof needed".

steps.name: Write guide
steps.prompt: Cover every objection supplied, copying it word for word into objection. Keep each response under 60 words. For proof, copy a supplied proof point exactly or write "proof needed". End each with an open follow-up question.

steps.name: Check guide
steps.responsibility: Objections are the ones supplied; responses are short; none repeated.

criteria.description: Every objection is copied from your list word for word.
Each response is 60 words or fewer.
